reason: User rejected generic brawler design; redesign as a masked underground racer.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, full character redesign for DAYTONA in Sandbox Wars. Images 1 E2B and 2 Modal are the USER-APPROVED gold-standard STYLE references. Match their stylized adult arcade/anime anatomy, angular facial features, selective crisp dark pixel outlines, broad clean shaded color masses and compact 3-4 tone shading ramps. Do NOT copy their hair/clothes/mask designs. This is a new original fictional underground STREET RACER fighter, not a factual depiction of Daytona's branding. Replace the generic spiky blue-haired hoodie boxer with a memorable masked character.

CHARACTER: tall lean athletic adult human male in his late twenties, medium warm skin, sharp eyebrows, shaved dark sidecut and slicked-back COBALT hair ending in a short pointed ponytail at nape, no big spiky anime hair. Wraparound AMBER racing goggles rest pushed UP on forehead so expressive eyes are visible. LOWER FACE covered by a striking WHITE angular carbon-composite RACING RESPIRATOR: long wedge-shaped nose bridge and tapered jaw, dark triangular ventilation slots, a single thin CYAN strip on either cheek, dark attachment straps. Aerodynamic human sports mask, NOT an oni/demon/skull, no fangs, no animal snout, no giant fish, no full motorcycle helmet, no hood. Mask identity must be clear at small game size.
CLOTHING: asymmetrical BLACK-and-CYAN cropped racing jacket worn zipped diagonally, high short collar, WHITE hard-shell plate on one shoulder, opposite upper arm has a fitted black short sleeve with white racing stripe. Narrow fitted black undershirt; black riding gloves. Slim dark charcoal riding trousers with one prominent white knee panel, cyan side stripe on opposite thigh. Sleek calf-high black racing boots with white toes/heel and cyan ankle highlights. Two short flat cyan harness tails attached at belt, always close to leg, no detached streamers. Subtle small speedometer-like cyan wrist display, no huge gauntlets. Angular lean racer silhouette, distinctive WHITE MASK and WHITE SHOULDER graphic shapes over black/cyan, restrained amber only goggles. No logos, writing or numerals. Do not reuse plain hoodie, tank top, baggy boxer pants, E2B long coat, Modal green crystals or Cloudflare boilersuit. Adult stylized fighter proportions exactly in the E2B/Modal family; no chibi or photorealism.

PERSONALITY: cool cocky street-racing specialist waiting at the starting line. Hands relaxed at waist, one hand lightly gripping the opposite glove cuff, long staggered stance with knees slightly bent, weight over rear leg; not crouched boxing guard. Same near/far equipment sides in every image. Small white shoulder plate always on near/viewer-left shoulder. Goggles remain on forehead, white respirator remains on lower face in ALL poses.

ATLAS: square true-alpha transparent PNG with EXACTLY 9 cells in strict 3x3 equal square grid. Every figure inside own cell, at least 10% transparent padding on ALL cell edges, max standing height 76% of cell including hair and boots. Particularly leave a real empty horizontal gap between second-row boots and bottom-row hair! No overlapping cells, stray fragments, clipping, floating pixels, background, checkerboard drawing, ground, shadows, text, labels or grid.
TOP SIX CELLS: six near-identical CLEAN idle frames of same stance and character, subtle breathing/shoulder rise and fall only. Same body scale, same planted feet coordinates and baseline. No gesture changes, new injuries, mask shape changes or switching shoulder plate. Pose6 connects smoothly to1.
BOTTOM LEFT: battered defeat, seated on ground with knees bent, one gloved hand holding forehead just above raised goggles, other rests on knee, respirator scratched but still attached, shoulder panel cracked, jacket scuffed, small cheekbone bandage above mask. Human eyes annoyed. No blood or missing gear.
BOTTOM CENTER: battered victory, standing exhausted with one hand adjusting goggles on forehead and other on hip, same scratched mask and cracked shoulder panel, visible weary confident eyes, same cheekbone bandage. Full raised elbow fits padded cell. Not fist pump or peace sign.
BOTTOM RIGHT: CLEAN large head-and-shoulders portrait, same adult angular face, expressive eyes, slicked-back cobalt sidecut, amber goggles pushed forehead, unmistakable white aerodynamic vented half-mask, black/cyan asym racing collar and white shoulder plate. No bandages/injuries in clean portrait. Keep full headgear/hair inside cell.
Nine consistent depictions of ONE redesigned masked racer. The strongest identity cues are white wedge respirator, amber forehead goggles, swept-back cobalt sidecut and asymmetric white/cyan racing panels. Reference-quality mature arcade pixel art.
